services.desc: About Inshore and Backwater Fishing: Northeast Florida offers world-class inshore and backwater fishing every month of the year. This is where we fish most of the time. Here we target Redfish, Flounder, Speckled Sea Trout and Black Drum on light tackle. Whether you prefer lure, live bait or fly-fishing, Captain Ron Can specifically tune your fishing adventure regardless of your skill level.
